svg.title: SEDNA / Story and references
svg.desc: SEDNA — Explore the Unseen. Visual identity, November 14, 2026.

g.aria-label: SEDNA takes its name from 90377 Sedna, discovered in 2003. Its distant, elongated orbit prompted
research into the dynamics of the outer solar system, including hypotheses about a planet yet to be
The project lets people compare observations taken at different times, notice what changed, and ask
new questions about what they see.
Caltech / Discovery of a Candidate Inner Oort Cloud Planetoid
Sedna was discovered on November 14, 2003. The discovery was announced publicly in March 2004.
